d:
Yet another barfest from Naam Sujal, solidifying his position at the top of the lyrical game. Known for his witty punchlines and clever wordplay, he delivers yet again with unmatched creativity. This time, he flips the classic sample ‘Dafli Wale’, transforming the dafli into a metaphorical gun to take down his competitors. With his unique style and lyrical precision, Sujal continues to show why he’s a force to be reckoned with in the rap scene.
Song Credits
Track Name: Dafli Wale - The Hustle Flip
Written & Performed By: Naam Sujal
Music Producer: Aditya Pushkarna
Primary Artist: Naam Sujal
